description: Five machine-callable trust services — claim verification, citation audits, structured extraction, news tripwires, proof-of-work audits — free during the pilot at https://shoon-a2a-sandbox.onrender.com. Every task is private to its buyer; deliverables are Ed25519-signed (key id sandbox-ed25519-7fe549f937c6) and verifiable offline.

privacy: Per-task 256-bit read token (Bearer header) required for task status, deliverable, signature check, and that task's ledger entries. Missing or wrong token returns 401.
